measurement: Venture Global cash capital expenditures separated into named LNG terminal projects versus nonterminal and financing categories
interpretation: Named project spending is more specific than company total cash capex but may include non-construction expenses attributed to projects.
Nonterminal and unallocated bucket includes pipelines, LNG tankers, capitalized interest and other; not an estimate of waste or avoidable cost.
Cash spent on a project is not evidence that the project was completed or that the amount represents project lifetime cost.
Cheniere consolidated PP&E cash flow remains separate and is not combined into the Venture Global facility-only subtotal.
These figures are derived arithmetic from a single SEC company filing, not a new independent evidence source.
